authority: Design reference; runtime manifests and VCMI validation remain authoritative.

silhouettes.town: vertical gothic aristocratic spires with readable terrace hierarchy
silhouettes.t2: elegant mobile duelists with sweeping thorn-ribbon arcs

productionRules: Town background must remain readable at 800x374.
Building upgrades preserve lineage and footprint readability.
Creature upgrades preserve base silhouette family.
Generated board text is never gameplay data.
Concept boards do not advance runtime asset status.
Runtime assets require exact-path files plus local VCMI validation.
